title: Walk 5,000 steps outdoors
description: Leave the headphones at home for the first half. Just walk and observe.

title: Drink 8 glasses of water
description: Keep a bottle nearby and finish it before dinner.

title: Plan tomorrow in 10 minutes
description: Write the top 3 things you want to finish tomorrow and when you will do them.

title: Read 20 pages of a real book
description: No phone, no audiobook. Just a book and a quiet space.

title: Cook one meal from scratch
description: Pick a simple meal and prepare it without ordering in.

title: Have a real conversation
description: Call or meet someone and keep your phone away for the whole talk.

title: Do a full 30-minute workout
description: No shortcuts. Move continuously for the full half hour.

title: Clean one difficult area
description: Pick a drawer, shelf, or corner you have been avoiding and reset it completely.
